body.heading: Look closely
paragraphs: Sit in front of the mirror. Where are your eyes? Halfway down your head, which surprises most people.
Notice the shapes: your eyes are ovals, your nose is lines and shadows, your smile is a curve.

body.heading: Draw what you see
paragraphs: Draw slowly, looking up often. Portraits do not need to be perfect; they need to be yours.
Finish with your happiest smile. Sign your name like a real artist.

takeaway: Your own face is the first portrait every artist learns to draw.
safetyNotes: Hold the mirror carefully with your adult, or use one fixed to a wall.
screenFreeExtension: Draw a portrait of someone in your family while they pull a funny face.
